extraction.Name: Reason Didier
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Yes, all of the taxes since 1924
extraction.NOTES: Patent was issued while allottee was in the War; he had no chance to make any answer to it as he did not know anything about it until it had been issued. He states the United States should make some kind of settlement for issuing the patent in fee before the end of the trust period. Mortgage and taxes due in August; expects to redeem mortgage and taxes. No one depends on him except himself. He does not live on the allotment but it joins the place he lives on and he uses it. Patent sent in spring of 1928.
